  "thinking": "Sofia has already set the fish plan and given out roles. Fighting it would waste time, so I'll take the tail. The one risk is the start: someone has to lay it, and the lines need to flow from it. I'll flag that briefly and wait for her sketch.",
  "say": "Fish works for me, I'll take the tail. Sofia, one thing when you sketch: put the start at the nose, with the top and bottom lines both leaving from there. They'll meet again at the back, and I'll build the tail off that join. Shout once the strokes are on the pad.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 7,
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Going with Sofia's fish. I'm on the tail, built off the join where the top and bottom lines meet at the back. Check that the start sits at the nose and that stroke 1 is covered. Once the pad is drawn, trace the tail strokes. Inspect the whole chain before time is up."
